title: Bihar Swasthya Suraksha Samiti / PM-JAY implementation Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: State implementation framework through which eligible Bihar beneficiaries receive government-funded hospitalization protection.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility is determined by the current PM-JAY/state beneficiary database and notified categories.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Bihar Swasthya Suraksha Samiti / PM-JAY implementation.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
